user_instruction: 건물이나 배경을 판정할때 직각이어야 하는건 직각으로. 생성형은 직선을 뭉개는 경향이 있기 때문에
principles: Intended source straight lines must remain straight; intended right-angle corners must remain right-angle corners. Sharpness/material attractiveness cannot offset bowed lines, rounded construction corners or changed grid spacing.
Record source anchors/segments/rectangular regions before accepting architectural repaint. Preserve perspective slopes and intentional arcs/fractures; do not force all image angles to90 degrees.

Use source-coordinate vector/geometry layers for structure and confine generated texture to interiors when a model changes boundaries. Separate source shading/dither from actual structural boundaries.
Review whole layout and native-resolution corners/line segments on both mattes for alpha assets; record count/spacing, positional alignment and alpha/consumer limits.
Candidate files made before this user instruction require a geometry applicability review. Historical material QA counts are retained but are not final geometry acceptance.
